bounded_question: Which neutral square deployment envelope, if any, allows the exact immutable C0 Threshold K to function as a design-master app icon across compact scales and accessibility modes without changing C0 geometry, depending on color/material, or claiming Store/package/runtime authority?

source.authority: PKT-SYM-01-01 provisional incumbent; SYM-02 zero-survivor closure; DUR-01 durability PASS

candidate_variable: Only symmetric square-canvas inset around exact C0. C0 aspect ratio and all three path d attributes remain byte/semantic identical; transforms may scale and center the unchanged source geometry.

required_checks: exact C0 canonical LF source and path-semantic hashes preserved
three paths per candidate with identical d attributes
zero external resources and zero raster/generated imagery

promotion_floor: A survivor must pass full mechanical/accessibility preflight and avoid both cramped edge pressure and over-small/generic glyph behavior at compact sizes. Exact C0 geometry may not be altered to rescue an envelope. If multiple materially viable envelopes survive, Design Sol freezes an independent ranking and returns the consequential app-icon composition choice to the Director.
excluded_variables: C0 path/anatomy refinement or new symbol concepts
CLR F2/F1 selection or palette tokens
Phase C exit by APPICON-01 alone
sequence: construct one neutral exact-C0 E06/E12/E18 comparison carrier
run mechanical/accessibility preflight and repair carrier defects before scoring
Design Sol evaluates only after clean preflight with no result-aware retuning
if multiple survivors remain, stop for Director app-icon composition adjudication
packetize closure and run post-APPICON reentry audit before any new program

recursive_audit.approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
